articles.title: Why China Suspended La Liga Broadcasts After Kylian Mbappé's 'Dictator' Remark About Mao Zedong: Full Controversy Explained
articles.summary: Kylian Mbappé has issued an apology after a video in which he appeared to describe China's founding leader Mao Zedong as a dictator triggered a backlash
articles.body: Kylian Mbappé has issued an apology after a video in which he appeared to describe China's founding leader Mao Zedong as a dictator triggered a backlash in China, costing the Real Madrid forward commercial partnerships and prompting Chinese state media to suspend broadcasts of Spanish football league matches featuring him.The controversy erupted after a clip of Mbappé discussing his favourite meme circulated on social media. His comments drew criticism from Chinese authorities, football officials and commercial partners, with demands for both the French footballer and his club, Real Madrid, to issue formal public apologies.In response, Mbappé acknowledged that his words had caused offence and expressed regret over the reaction in China.“My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world,” he said in a statement on Tuesday.“I apologize to everyone my words have upset. This was absolutely not my intention. I have deep respect for the Chinese people and their history, and I am sincerely sorry.”What did Mbappé say about Mao Zedong?The controversy stems from a video in which Mbappé was asked to identify his favourite meme featuring himself.The French forward replied that it was “a video someone made of a guy ... I think he was a Chinese dictator”. The clip then showed an edited image placing Mbappé's face on the body of Mao Zedong, China's revolutionary leader and the founder of the People's Republic of China.Football fans on social media frequently use the term 'dictator' jokingly to describe Mbappé, who is often portrayed in memes as overshadowing his teammates and even the clubs he represents. Images depicting him as Mao and other authoritarian leaders have also circulated online.However, the reference to Mao proved particularly sensitive in China, where the former leader continues to be revered by many despite the controversial legacy of his rule.Mao led the Communist Party through its formative years and its victory over the Nationalist Party in the civil war, before establishing the People's Republic of China. His rule also included campaigns such as the Great Leap Forward, an industrialisation drive that contributed to a famine estimated to have killed around 30 million people.The combination of the dictator reference and the edited image prompted criticism in China, turning what appeared to be a joke about a football meme into a wider controversy.Why has China suspended La Liga broadcasts?The fallout extended beyond Mbappé after Chinese authorities and state media demanded an apology from the player and Real Madrid.China Media Group announced that it had suspended broadcasts of matches in La Liga and other games featuring the French star. It also removed advertisements featuring him and called on Mbappé and Real Madrid to issue apologies.The China Football Association separately said it had “lodged a stern protest” with Real Madrid and demanded a “public and formal apology” from both the player and the club. It said it firmly opposed remarks that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people.The broadcast suspension puts La Liga's commercial relationship with China under pressure, given the country's importance as a market for the Spanish competition.La Liga responded by distancing itself from the comments, saying Mbappé had spoken in a personal capacity and did not represent the league.In a statement, it said it “deeply regrets the offense caused to Chinese fans by Mbappé's recent comments”.The league also announced plans to introduce a communication protocol for players and clubs, while working with stakeholders in China to prevent similar incidents in the future.La Liga president Javier Tebas later said on X that he had met China's ambassador to Spain, Yao Jing, to discuss the controversy and seek a resolution.Tebas reiterated the league's commitment to maintaining its partnerships with China, including its strategic agreement with the Chinese league through 2029 and its deals with China Media Group.“Our commitment is to keep working together so that an individual episode does not harm the important advances achieved nor affect the millions of Chinese fans who follow our competitions. China is and will continue to be a strategic partner for La Liga,” Tebas said.Three Chinese brands end partnerships with MbappéThe backlash has also affected Mbappé's commercial interests in China, where his image has featured prominently in advertising campaigns, from subway stations to elevator displays.Beverage company Dongpeng, dairy giant Mengniu and cheese maker Milkground announced on Tuesday that they were ending their agreements with the footballer.The companies issued similarly worded statements opposing “any words and actions that hurt national sentiment”. Although they did not specify the precise reason for their decisions, their announcements followed the circulation of the video featuring Mbappé's comments about Mao.Mbappé has appeared in campaigns for products ranging from electrolyte drinks to milk and cheese. One Dongpeng advertisement featured him delivering a slogan in Chinese, while a Mengniu commercial showed him alongside Argentine football star Lionel Messi.Chinese social media platform RedNote also joined the criticism. It said its content partnership with Mbappé had ended on December 31, 2024, and announced that it would remove related promotional material. The platform expressed opposition to “any conduct that hurts national sentiment”.Mbappé's RedNote account was also banned from accepting new followers on Tuesday.On Weibo, hashtags relating to Dongpeng ending its partnership with the footballer and several brands cutting ties with him topped the trending list. Calls to boycott Mbappé also gained traction, with some users criticising his remarks and telling him not to visit China.A wider pattern of commercial fallout in ChinaThe controversy is the latest example of the repercussions foreign public figures and organisations can face in China over remarks perceived as offensive to the country.In 2019, Chinese state television stopped broadcasting NBA games after Daryl Morey, then general manager of the Houston Rockets, tweeted in support of anti-government protesters in Hong Kong.The latest episode has similarly drawn in commercial partners, sports administrators and broadcasters, with La Liga attempting to contain the damage to its relationship with Chinese audiences.While Mbappé has apologised and the Spanish league has distanced itself from his comments, the incident has highlighted how a remark made in the context of an online football meme can escalate into a dispute with consequences for broadcasting and commercial partnerships.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.standfirst: Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham Forest) se ha convertido en el último jugador de la Premier League en sufrir un robo en su domicilio
articles.summary: Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham Forest) se ha convertido en el último jugador de la Premier League en sufrir un robo en su domicilio
articles.body: Morgan Gibbs-White, futbolista del Nottingham Forest que ha sido 10 veces internacional con Inglaterra, se ha convertido en el último jugador de la Premier League en sufrir un robo en su domicilio. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) vivió una situación similar la semana pasada mientras se encontraba en Italia con su club para disputar un partido de la Champions League. Se tiene constancia de que bandas delictivas aprovechan la ausencia de estrellas del fútbol, que se encuentran disputando partidos fuera de casa con sus respectivos clubes, para asaltar sus residencias. Entre los últimos afectados se encuentran jugadores como Paul Pogba, Victor Lindelof, Jesse Lingard, Rúben Dias y Joao Cancelo. Con anterioridad también asaltaron las casas de Gianluigi Donnarumma, Alexander Isak, Jack Grealish, Raheem Sterling o Riyad Mahrez. La modelo e influencer Britney De Villiers, quien reside en Nottinghamshire junto Morgan Gibbs-White, compartió un mensaje en Instagram con el fin de advertir a los futbolistas de la Premier para que permanezcan alerta. "No tenía intención de compartir esto públicamente, pero hace unos días entraron a robar en nuestra casa. Tras enterarme de otro caso reciente, considero importante advertir a los demás. Resulta sumamente inquietante saber que hay viviendas que están siendo objeto de estos delitos. Por favor, extremen las precauciones, asegúrense de que sus sistemas de seguridad estén activados —estén o no en casa— y denuncien cualquier actividad sospechosa", publicó la pareja de Morgan Gibbs-White. Britney De Villiers contó, sobre el robo en su domicilio, que "afortunadamente, no había nadie en casa cuando ocurrió; los bienes materiales pueden reemplazarse, pero es una sensación horrible saber que alguien ha invadido tu hogar, especialmente cuando tienes hijos pequeños". "Por favor, cuídense mucho y velen unos por otros", pidió. Gibbs-White y De Villiers se conocieron en 2019 y se comprometieron en junio de 2025. Tienen dos hijos pequeños, Greyson y Hayes.

articles.title: Liverpool may be sleepwalking into diabolical 2027 transfer mistake – opinion
articles.summary: Jose Mourinho is reportedly keen on Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister.Sky Sports Germany claim that the Argentine star is high on Real Madrid’s wishli...
articles.body:
Jose Mourinho is reportedly keen on Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister.

Sky Sports Germany claim that the Argentine star is high on Real Madrid's wishlist, with the Spanish outfit paying close attention to the situation ahead of the footballer's contract expiring in the summer of 2028.

On current evidence, Liverpool should keep Alexis Mac Allister

There were suspicions that a truly horrendous domestic campaign from the former Brighton man would culminate in his departure from Anfield this summer.

However, following an impressive (and evidently rejuvenating) World Cup campaign with Argentina, we've seen Mac Allister reborn in the middle of the park for Andoni Iraola's men . In fact, there's a pretty convincing case you could make for the 27-year-old being a strong contender, alongside Jeremy Jacquet, for Liverpool's player of the season, as things currently stand.

There were serious concerns about the midfielder's legs being gone, given he's endured a relentless run of fixtures between his involvement across Brighton, Liverpool and the national side.

But if we're seeing this version of Alexis Mac Allister every week, and there's hope for some longevity beyond the end of his contract, you have to wonder whether Liverpool might be tempted to extend his current terms – even if only to protect his value.

The case for selling Mac Allister to Real Madrid

Reporting from Sky Sports Switzerland claims that Liverpool are firm on the idea that they won't be offering their leading performer a contract extension, despite Mac Allister being more than open to extending his stay at L4.

Why? Well, the Reds are reportedly planning another midfield overhaul, and so Mac Allister is presumably one name that could be sacrificed on the transfer pyre in the interest of bringing in a quality signing.

There is some sense in this approach; the former Seagulls man is, currently, one of our more valuable assets. But if you're selling a player with a year left on his contract, you're opening yourself to being bullied on the price tag (if you're not prepared to risk a free exit) without a bidding war, and it seems like Real Madrid are the only really keen suitors at this stage.

But, realistically, what are Liverpool hoping to achieve with this? Because on current evidence, Alexis Mac Allister is the one senior midfielder who appears to have taken to Andoni Iraola's methods like a duck to water. He sits deeper than Ryan Gravenberch and Dominik Szoboszlai, and his passing is considerably more impactful – is there an expectation that either of his teammates will improve in that regard?

We all broadly agree that bringing in a more natural six would be a sound move for the recruitment team. But would selling the Argentina international really be in our best interests? We're going to need to see some serious improvement from Szoboszlai and Gravenberch to justify it.

articles.body:
The UEFA Women's Champions League is back, and the Women's First Team are heading to Austria to take on Austria Wien on Matchday 3 of the League Phase.

Isaac Guerrero's side lost their opening UWCL game 2-1 against Benfica. but won 3-0 away at Hacken to get the campaign off the mark on Matchday 2.

Let's get up to speed ahead of the game with the pre-match stats.

The meeting between Austria Wien and Juventus will be their first-ever UEFA Women's Champions League match; overall, Italian teams are unbeaten against Austrian sides in the competition (W8, D3).

Juventus are unbeaten in their last four UEFA Women's Champions League away games (W3, D1) after losing three in a row previously; the Bianconere's biggest away win in the competition came in their only previous meeting in Austria (5-0 against St. Pölten in December 2025).

Juventus has the third-most recoveries from pressing situations in the UWCL this season (33, behind only Arsenal and Barcelona).

Alba Redondo of Juventus has attempted the most shots of any player in this UEFA Women's Champions League season (14) and has scored in both of her matches in the tournament.

Alba Redondo has been directly involved in 12 of Juventus' 28 goals this season, across all competitions, with nine goals and three assists (43%).

Austria Wien are yet to win after their first two UEFA Women's Champions League matches (D1, L1); however, they picked up their first-ever points in the competition on Matchday 2 against Italian opposition (1-1 against Inter).

No team has had more different players score than Austria Wien in the 2026/27 Austrian Championship: 11 in 10 matches played, the same as St. Pölten.

Among the 221 players to have attempted 25 or more passes in the 2026/27 UEFA Women's Champions League, Jasmin Pal of Austria Wien boasts the highest percentage of forward passes (78%, 53 out of 68).

articles.title: Sorpresa en Copa de Liga: Arsenal se estrella ante el Fleetwood Town de 4ª división por penales
articles.standfirst: Hay tres enfrentamientos más entre equipos de la Liga Premier: Bournemouth vs. Aston Villa, Fulham vs. Crystal Palace y Sunderland vs. Brentford.
articles.summary: Hay tres enfrentamientos más entre equipos de la Liga Premier: Bournemouth vs. Aston Villa, Fulham vs. Crystal Palace y Sunderland vs. Brentford.
articles.body: El Arsenal se estrelló ante el Fleetwood Town de cuarta división en una tanda de penales el martes, una de las mayores sorpresas en los 66 años de historia de la Copa de la Liga inglesa. El campeón de la Liga Premier quedó así eliminado en el duelo de octavos de final. Cinco meses después de perder en una tanda de penales contra el Paris Saint-Germain en la final de la Liga de Campeones, el Arsenal sufrió otra decepción desde los 11 pasos — esta vez en el estadio Highbury, con capacidad para 5.300 espectadores. El pequeño campo del Fleetwood lleva el mismo nombre que el antiguo estadio del Arsenal, su casa entre 1913 y 2006. Fleetwood — un equipo 84 puestos más abajo que el Arsenal en la pirámide del fútbol inglés— convirtió todos sus penales contra el campeón de la Liga Premier y ganó 5-3 en la tanda desde los 11 pasos. Bruno Guimaraes del Arsenal vio atajado un penal en el único intento fallado en la tanda. El partido terminó 1-1 en el tiempo regular —el Arsenal se quedó con 10 hombres tras una tarjeta roja al prodigio de 16 años Max Dowman. "Un día realmente triste para nosotros", reconoció el técnico español del Arsenal Mikel Arteta, quien dejó fuera a algunas figuras del primer equipo como Declan Rice, Gabriel y David Raya — pero aun así eligió una alineación fuerte con internacionales experimentados. Los eufóricos aficionados locales invadieron el campo después de que Conor Haughey convirtió el penal decisivo para el Fleetwood, que nunca había llegado antes a esta instancia de la competición y que —en el 18vo puesto de la League Two— era el club de menor rango que quedaba en la contienda. "Ha sido la noche más grande en la historia del club en términos del rival que viene a la ciudad y hemos logrado vencer a los campeones" de la Premier, dijo el técnico del Fleetwood Matt Lawlor. El arquero del Fleetwood Jay Lynch, la figura de la tanda después de desviar el intento de Guimaraes, dijo que el equipo se inspiró en otra sorpresa de la Copa de la Liga lograda por un equipo de cuarta división la temporada pasada. "Nos animó Grimsby, que venció al Man United el año pasado", dijo Lynch. "Más o menos lo comparamos. Fue increíble para el club, la ciudad. Honestamente significa todo para todos". El Arsenal, abajo por un gol conseguido a los 21 minutos por el delantero del Fulham cedido a préstamo Aaron Loupalo-Bi, metió al capitán Martin Odegaard al descanso para volver al partido. Viktor Gyokeres igualó a los 50, pero el Arsenal tuvo dificultades para generar muchas ocasiones claras después de eso y vio expulsado a Dowman a los 85 por lanzar una patada a un rival que lo había derribado con una dura entrada. Dowman pareció recibir una reprimenda de Arteta al salir del campo. "Tenemos una enorme responsabilidad de llevar este escudo de la mejor manera posible", dijo Arteta. "No tuvo nada que ver con el esfuerzo o la aplicación o la determinación de ganarlo, pero nos faltaron otras cosas." Equipo conocido por Vardy Fleetwood es un club apenas conocido. Su sede homónima es una ciudad costera del noroeste de Inglaterra, y el conjunto languidece en el 18vo puesto de la League Two. Es más famoso por ser el equipo donde el exdelantero de la selección de Inglaterra y de Leicester Jamie Vardy se dio a conocer. Estuvo allí apenas una temporada y ayudó al Fleetwood a lograr el ascenso desde la quinta división, y a entrar en la English Football League, antes de fichar por el Leicester en 2012. En 2023, al expropietario del Fleetwood, Andy Pilley, se le impuso una condena de 13 años de cárcel por fraude. Perdió una apelación en febrero de este año. Un dron detiene el partido Un dron que sobrevolaba el estadio provocó una demora de ocho minutos poco después de que el partido había comenzado. El Arsenal estaba a punto de ejecutar un tiro libre dentro del segundo minuto cuando el árbitro vio el dron y detuvo temporalmente el juego, lo que provocó abucheos de algunos aficionados. El árbitro habló con el encargado de seguridad del estadio, ambos técnicos y luego con algunos de los jugadores antes de finalmente reanudar el partido. Más dolor en tanda de penales para Guimaraes Quizás Guimaraes debería dejar de patear penales. El mediocampista vio atajado un penal en la derrota de Brasil ante Noruega en los octavos de final de la Copa del Mundo disputada en el verano boreal. Bradford de 3ra división a los cuartos de final — y con antecedentes Bradford City representará a la tercera división de Inglaterra en los cuartos de final — 13 años después de llegar a la final de la competición cuando jugaba en la cuarta categoría. Venció a Peterborough por 2-0 y se unirá al Fleetwood como los equipos de ligas inferiores en el sorteo del miércoles para la ronda de los ocho mejores. En 2013, Bradford se convirtió en el primer equipo de cuarta división en más de 50 años en llegar a la final y perdió 5-0 ante Swansea en el estadio de Wembley. Eliminó al Arsenal en el camino al partido por el título esa temporada. Más partidos el miércoles Los octavos de final continúan este miércoles con cinco partidos más, encabezados por el del campeón defensor Manchester City, que recibe al Brighton, y el de Liverpool, anfitrión del Chelsea. Hay tres enfrentamientos más entre equipos de la Liga Premier: Bournemouth vs. Aston Villa, Fulham vs. Crystal Palace y Sunderland vs. Brentford. El jueves, Everton recibe a Newcastle.

articles.title: Spurs defender Sombath sustains ACL injury
articles.summary: Tottenham Hotspur defender Alice Sombath has sustained an Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) injury.WSL Full-Time were informed of the news via an official med...
articles.body:
Tottenham Hotspur defender Alice Sombath has sustained an Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) injury.

WSL Full-Time were informed of the news via an official media update from The Lilywhites last night.

The 23-year-old sustained the injury during the second half of Saturday's Barclays Women's Super League fixture against North London rivals Arsenal at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Sombath left the field on a stretcher in the 50th minute and was replaced by Ella Morris.

Sombath's injury has been fully-assessed by the Tottenham Hotspur medical team and it has been confirmed that she has ruptured her Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL). The player is now expected to miss the remainder of the season as she begins her rehabilitation.

Spurs signed Sombath from French Arkema Première Ligue club OL Lyonnes in the summer for an undisclosed fee. The player arrived in England with plenty of experience of winning trophies. Sombath won 10 trophies at former club OL Lyonnes including five league titles and a UEFA Women's Champions League.

Sombath has made six appearances for the North Londoners in all competitions this season. She made her first league start against Arsenal at the weekend.

Further updates on Sombath's fitness will be provided by Spurs in due course.

articles.title: FEATURE | Five standout players from Bundesliga Matchday 7

articles.body:
Bundesliga Matchday 7 produced another entertaining weekend of German football, with Bayern Munich maintaining their unbeaten start, Borussia Dortmund securing an important victory over Eintracht Frankfurt and RB Leipzig recording the biggest win of the round.

Werder Bremen continued their impressive run with another victory inspired by Niclas Füllkrug, while Borussia Mönchengladbach claimed their first three points of the season against Stuttgart. Hoffenheim also produced one of the weekend's biggest surprises by defeating Bayer Leverkusen 3-0.

Here are five players whose individual performances made the difference for their teams.

Niclas Füllkrug continues to demonstrate why returning to Werder Bremen was one of the best decisions of his career.

The German international scored twice in Bremen's 3-2 victory over Mainz, converting penalties in the seventh and 25th minutes to give Daniel Thioune's side an early advantage.

Although Mainz fought back through Anthony Caci and Lee Jae-sung, Ludovit Reis scored Bremen's third goal to secure an important away victory.

Füllkrug has now scored eight goals in seven Bundesliga matches, making him the competition's leading goalscorer. His remarkable form is not only helping Bremen collect valuable points but also strengthening the argument that he deserves another opportunity with the Germany national team.

Rômulo was instrumental in RB Leipzig's convincing 4-0 victory over newly promoted Elversberg.

After Tidiam Gomis opened the scoring shortly after half-time, the Brazilian striker doubled Leipzig's advantage in the 66th minute before completing his brace in stoppage time. Christoph Baumgartner also found the net as Martín Demichelis' side secured their fourth Bundesliga victory of the campaign.

Rômulo's movement inside the penalty area and ability to convert opportunities demonstrated why he can become an important attacking option for Leipzig.

After an inconsistent start to the season, Leipzig need their forwards to produce goals regularly if they are to challenge for European qualification. Rômulo's performance provided exactly that.

Joe Scally played an important role as Borussia Mönchengladbach secured their first Bundesliga victory of the season with a dramatic 3-2 win away at Stuttgart.

The American defender scored Gladbach's equaliser in the 38th minute after Ermedin Demirović had given Stuttgart an early lead.

Shuto Machino and Wael Mohya subsequently extended Gladbach's advantage before Demirović scored again late in the match, but the visitors held on for a desperately needed victory.

Scally's goal was particularly significant given Gladbach's difficult start to the campaign. His attacking contribution helped change the momentum of the match and provided an important foundation for a result that could restore some confidence within the squad.

Andrej Kramarić transformed Hoffenheim's encounter against Bayer Leverkusen after coming off the bench, inspiring Christian Ilzer's side to a surprising 3-0 victory.

With the match still goalless, the Croatian converted a penalty in the 79th minute to score Hoffenheim's 1,000th Bundesliga goal.

He then provided the assist for Alexander Prass to double the advantage before his own effort struck the crossbar, allowing Max Moerstedt to score the third in stoppage time.

Kramarić's influence was particularly impressive considering he only entered the match in the second half. His experience, creativity and composure helped Hoffenheim end Leverkusen's five-match unbeaten run and secure their first Bundesliga clean sheet of the season.

Dayot Upamecano delivered an outstanding all-round performance as Bayern Munich defeated Freiburg 3-1 to maintain their position at the top of the Bundesliga.

The French defender produced one of the most impressive individual sequences of the weekend in the 16th minute. After stopping a Freiburg attack inside Bayern's penalty area, Upamecano helped initiate a counterattack, carried his run forward and eventually finished the move himself following an assist from Michael Olise.

Serge Gnabry doubled Bayern's advantage before half-time, while Olise scored in stoppage time after Freiburg had reduced the deficit through a Tom Bischof own goal.

Beyond his goal, Upamecano recorded more touches than any Bayern teammate, produced one of the team's highest passing accuracy figures and won 58% of his duels.

His performance demonstrated why he remains such an important figure in Bayern's defensive structure, combining physical strength with the confidence to contribute to attacking transitions.

Matchday 7 offered another fascinating collection of individual performances. Füllkrug continued his remarkable goalscoring form, Rômulo inspired Leipzig, Scally helped Gladbach secure their first victory, Kramarić transformed Hoffenheim's attack and Upamecano produced an exceptional performance at both ends of the pitch.

All five demonstrated how individual quality can influence matches in different ways, making them deserving selections among the Bundesliga's standout performers this weekend.

articles.title: A qué hora es el Tavernes - Valencia: dónde ver, canal y dónde ver en TV hoy el partido de Copa del Rey
articles.standfirst: El conjunto de La Safor vive una noche histórica ante el Valencia en Mestalla
articles.summary: El conjunto de La Safor vive una noche histórica ante el Valencia en Mestalla
articles.body: El Tavernes y el Valencia se enfrentan hoy miércoles 28 de octubre a las 21:00 horas en la primera ronda de la Copa del Rey. Será una eliminatoria muy particular, porque aunque el Tavernes ejerce como equipo local, el encuentro se disputará en Mestalla, la casa del Valencia. La RFEF confirmó el cambio de escenario después de la petición presentada por el Tavernes. La decisión no modificó ni la fecha ni el horario del encuentro: el Valencia tendrá formalmente la condición de visitante pese a jugar en su propio estadio. La cita representa un acontecimiento histórico para el conjunto de La Safor. El Tavernes se proclamó campeón de la Nostra Copa y posteriormente superó al Maracena para alcanzar esta fase de la Copa del Rey. El equipo milita en la Lliga Comunitat, sexta categoría del fútbol español. La expectación se ha trasladado también a las gradas. El club había vendido cerca de 5.000 entradas y organizado alrededor de 25 autocares para desplazar seguidores desde Tavernes hasta Valencia en las horas previas al partido. El Tavernes - Valencia correspondiente a la primera ronda de la Copa del Rey se disputa hoy miércoles 28 de octubre a las 21:00 horas en Mestalla, con el Tavernes como equipo local y el Valencia como visitante. El encuentro podrá verse en directo a través de M+ LALIGA 2, según la programación televisiva de MARCA. Toda la información previa y posterior del encuentro estará disponible también en MARCA.com, junto con el resultado y la actualidad de la jornada copera.

articles.title: Nottingham Forest ace Morgan Gibbs-White becomes the latest player to have his house burgled
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White is the latest Premier League player to have his house burgled. His fiancée, Britney De Villiers, revealed det...
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White is the latest Premier League player to have his house burgled. His fiancée, Britney De Villiers, revealed details of the incident on social media.

The South African model and influencer shared the news on Instagram, describing the experience as unsettling and horrible.

According to her, the burglary happened a few days earlier, and the family was shaken by the incident.

Fortunately, neither Gibbs-White nor De Villiers was at home when the property was targeted.

Their two young children, Greyson and Hayes, were also away from the house at the time, so no one in the family was in danger during the break-in.

Despite their safety, De Villiers admitted that the experience had left her feeling violated.

"I wasn't going to publicly share this, but our home was burgled a few days ago, and after hearing about another one since, I feel it's important to just warn others," she said (via the Daily Mail ).

"It's incredibly unsettling knowing that homes are being targeted.

"Please be extra vigilant, make sure your security systems are on whether you're in the house or not and report anything suspicious.

"Thankfully, nobody was home when it happened, and material things can be replaced, but it's a horrible feeling knowing someone has violated your home, especially when you have young children.

"Please stay safe and look out for one another."

Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes was also reportedly targeted in a separate incident less than a week earlier.

Three masked intruders broke into the Portuguese midfielder's £4 million mansion while he was in Italy, playing in United's 4-1 defeat against Como.

It's unclear whether Gibbs-White's home was burgled while Forest were playing Ipswich Town in their Premier League meeting on Friday.

The match ended in a 1-1 draw, extending Forest's winless streak to four Premier League games.

Oliver Glasner, who arrived at the club this summer on a reported £13 million-per-year contract , has struggled in his early days at City Ground.

articles.title: 🥐 Geopolitical crisis, shock sacking, surprises: Wednesday’s 5️⃣ stories
articles.summary: The geopolitical standoff between China and Kylian Mbappé shakes LaLiga’s financial foundations on a day of sporting contrasts: while Manolo González is abru...
articles.body:
The geopolitical standoff between China and Kylian Mbappé shakes LaLiga's financial foundations on a day of sporting contrasts: while Manolo González is abruptly sacked by Espanyol and Arsenal suffer an unforgettable cup humiliation against a fourth-tier side, Hansi Flick makes a move for Germany's latest wonderkid and Nico Paz dazzles in Italy.

China's state broadcaster has confirmed the complete suspension of LALIGA broadcasts and advertising content linked to Kylian Mbappé. Beijing has flatly rejected Real Madrid's explanations, arguing that the French striker's remarks "go beyond freedom of expression," and is demanding an immediate apology from the club before resuming any commercial ties.

The Copa del Rey has claimed its first major managerial casualty. RCD Espanyol have sacked Manolo González following their humiliating 4-3 defeat to Sestao River. The cup exit compounds the club's poor run, and the board is already scouring the market for an urgent replacement to take charge.

At Barcelona, the sporting department is stepping up its efforts at the coach's express request. Hansi Flick has made Finn Jeltsch, the promising 20-year-old defender in German football, his top priority. Scouting reports back his potential to make an immediate impact in strengthening Barça's defence in the coming transfer windows.

In Italy, Como remain the team of the moment thanks to Nico Paz's talent. The attacker led a brilliant comeback away at Torino in a 3-1 win, recording a goal and an assist to cement his status as one of the Italian league's most dangerous breakout stars.

The day's biggest shock comes from England. Mikel Arteta's Arsenal were knocked out of the League Cup on penalties by lowly fourth-tier club Fleetwood Town. Even a starting spot for Martín Zubimendi could not prevent disaster for the Gunners, who finished with ten men after Max Dowman received a straight red card.

articles.title: Mourinho wastes no time after Real Madrid’s El Clasico win as details of return flight emerge – report
articles.summary: Real Madrid’s 2-1 victory over Barcelona at the Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday will be remembered as the night when Jose Mourinho’s project truly took flight.Los...
articles.body:
Real Madrid's 2-1 victory over Barcelona at the Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday will be remembered as the night when Jose Mourinho's project truly took flight.

Los Blancos now find themselves just three points behind their rivals in La Liga . Despite the importance of Sunday's result, Mourinho does not want his players to become complacent.

According to journalist Ben Fernandes Santos (h/t RM4Arab ), Mourinho and his coaching staff began analysing the Clasico during their flight back to Madrid.

Sources present on the aircraft confirmed that the technical team immediately started reviewing the performances, identifying areas for improvement.

Mourinho immediately turns attention to Racing Santander

Rather than simply celebrate the victory over Barça , Mourinho used the journey home to focus on the upcoming Racing Santander game.

Mourinho said as much after the Clasico , stressing that defeating Barcelona would mean little without backing it up with further results.

"If we win today and lose at El Sardinero, today's victory doesn't hold the same weight, because Real Madrid doesn't play to win at Camp Nou. Real Madrid plays to win championships," Mourinho said.

Jose Mourinho had one of his best management games in the El Clasico. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images)

Madrid's performance against Barcelona was encouraging, particularly their defensive organisation and ability to escape pressure through intelligent midfield combinations.

However, Sunday's victory also demonstrated the importance of maintaining concentration throughout matches.

Barcelona wrested back the momentum in the second half, and there was a period in the game when they looked more dangerous.

Real Madrid's mentality under Mourinho is changing

Interestingly, Mourinho previously explained that his coaching staff routinely prepare material for the next fixture immediately after matches, sometimes while travelling.

This working method offers an insight into the demanding standards he is attempting to establish during his second spell at the club.

Jose Mourinho is changing Real Madrid's mentality. (Photo by Tullio M. Puglia/Getty Images)

For Madrid, the real challenge is translating the intensity shown against Barcelona into consistent performances against less glamorous opponents.

Mourinho has already demonstrated a willingness to reconsider his tactical choices, particularly his midfield combinations and the use of Federico Valverde at right-back.

The Clasico provided evidence that those adjustments are working, but it is important to sustain that continuity.

Madrid have restored belief in their title ambitions. It remains to be seen how they fare against Racing Santander later this weekend.

articles.title: Mikel Arteta remains tight-lipped on Max Dowman reaction after 16-year-old’s red card
articles.summary: Arteta appeared to have harsh words for Dowman as the teeanger was sent off for violent conduct in the shock defeat at Fleetwood Town
articles.body:
Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta refused to provide further explanation to his angry reaction to Max Dowman 's red card in the Carabao Cup defeat to Fleetwood Town.

But Arteta revealed what he said to Dowman as he walked off the pitch was to do with "something we discussed already before the match".

Arteta appeared to have harsh words for the the 16-year-old Arsenal forward following the first red card of his senior career, which came as the Gunners lost on penalties .

Dowman was making his second start of the season for Arsenal after his stunning two-goal display against Ipswich in the previous round of the competition.

But Fleetwood made Arsenal's night a frustrating one and the League Two side were hanging on for penalties when Dowman was sent off in the 85th minute.

The teeanger was on the receiving end of a heavy challenge from behind from the Fleetwood midfielder Harrison Neal, who lunged at him near the touchline.

Dowman kicked out at Neal in response to his tackle, sparking a brawl between the teams as the Fleetwood players reacted angrily to the youngster's retaliation.

The referee Michael Salisbury, who did not have VAR available, showed Dowman a straight red card for violent conduct, leaving Arsenal down to 10 men.

And there looked to be an furious reaction from Arteta towards Dowman as he walked off the pitch and went straight down the tunnel.

The incident took place on the opposite side of the pitch to Arteta's dugout but the manager appeared to have sharp words for Dowman as he left the pitch.

Arteta said he still had to watch the incident back before commenting on it, but it was notable that he had no comforting words of support for the forward.

"It's difficult to see on the cameras like that so I'd prefer to watch it back properly so I can assess the situation," he told Sky Sports.

Asked if the 16-year-old can learn from the red card because of his young age, Arteta replied: "Yeah, we all learn from everything, yeah."

Then asked what he said to Dowman when he left the pitch, Arteta told BBC Radio 5 Live: "Something that we discussed already before the match."

Dowman will now be suspended for Arsenal's next three Premier League games, starting with Sunday's trip to Liverpool.

It comes as Arteta is expected to be without his first-choice right winger, Bukayo Saka, due to injury for the next few weeks.

And Arteta also revealed that his second-choice right winger Noni Madueke could be unavailable against Liverpool due to injury.

It suggests Dowman could have been in line to start for Arsenal at Liverpool prior to his sending off at Fleetwood.
